name: Skill Synthesis Request
about: Request a new skill or modification to an existing synthesized skill
title: '[Skill] '
labels: ['skill-synthesis']

---

## Skill Name
Proposed name for the skill.

## Purpose
What should this skill do? What domain does it belong to?

## Input Parameters
What inputs does the skill need? (parameters, data types, required vs optional)

## Expected Output
What does the skill return or produce?

## Source Domain
Which execution traces or workflows should this skill be synthesized from?

## Existing Similar Skills
Are there existing skills this resembles or should replace?

## Priority
- [ ] P0 - Critical
- [ ] P1 - High
- [ ] P2 - Medium
